subject: Cognitive Science
title: The Speech Perception Puzzle
description: A quick, practical guide to The Speech Perception Puzzle.

hook.text: There are no gaps between words in spoken speech. Say 'I scream' fast—it sounds identical to 'ice cream.'

buildup.text: Speech is a continuous acoustic stream. Your brain inserts word boundaries using context and expectation.

discovery.text: The brain uses top-down predictions to segment speech. It guesses the next word before it hears it.

twist.text: This is why you mishear song lyrics. Your brain fills in what it expects, not what was actually said.

climax.text: Listening isn't passive reception. It's active construction—your brain builds meaning from ambiguous input.

punchline.text: You don't hear words—you construct them.

quiz.question: Why do we mishear song lyrics?
options: The brain fills in expected words
